sentences.text: Highway to Heaven is an American television drama series which ran on NBC from 1984 to 1989 .	NBC	NBC
The series aired for five seasons , running a total of 111 episodes .
It was shot almost entirely in California .	California	California

The series starred Michael Landon as Jonathan Smith , and Victor French -- Landon 's co-star from Little House on the Prairie -- as Mark Gordon .	Michael Landon	Michael Landon	Victor French	Victor French	Little House on the Prairie	Little House on the Prairie (TV series)

causal_questions.question: Highway to Heaven is an American movie series.
